decisions.what: processor.go fans out over each account's vehicles now, keeping the account-keyed watermark.
decisions.why: The account-wide read cannot survive the column drop and has a production caller. The fan-out uses a port that already exists, so tier 3 undoes nothing.

decisions.what: SuperchargerHistoryByAccount and SuperchargerHistoryByAccountUpdatedSince are removed, not re-keyed.
decisions.why: Both filter on account_id alone. Dropping the parameter would leave a whole-table scan.

decisions.what: In the mirror fan-out, one vehicle's failed read skips the whole account: no mirror write, no watermark advance.
decisions.why: The cursor covers every car of the account at once. Advancing it after a partial read would push it past the missing car's rows, losing them silently.
